label: Mid-to-late original-phase step (t=4-7) right after a 2/3/g/p/t/o input
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase: 99% of activation mass. It is restricted to positions t=4-7 and peaks at t=5. It never fires at t<=2 or anywhere in the copy phase, and only weakly at the delimiter. Within that window it depends on the previous input token. Rate is highest after 2 (6x lift), then 3, g, p, t and o, with weaker lift after k and r. The top activations come right after a 2 (for example g c v i 2 [2] [y]). The current input token barely matters, but first occurrences are favored. More digits in the sequence raise the firing rate a little. The window alone covers 98% of mass but has precision 0.20. Adding the previous-token condition gives dev F1 0.67 and mass recall 0.81. Missed activations are mostly weak ones where a trigger token appeared two steps back or the token is outside the set. Many predicted steps are inactive, so the token set is only an approximation of a graded preference.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 2, 3, g, p, t, o; least: s, a, f, d) and the second original token (most: d, f, s, a, i, v; least: t, g, o, 2); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=6, t=4.
